title: Add PostgreSQL config and DB URL selection
description: Update src/config.py to add POSTGRES_* and DATABASE_URL override; build DB URL selection; keep SQLite fallback; handle DATABASE_PATH/DATA_DIR; only create local dirs for SQLite.
acceptance_criteria: PG env returns PostgreSQL URL; SQLite fallback preserved; DATABASE_PATH or DATA_DIR handled for auth.
findings: Added DATABASE_URL override and PostgreSQL URL builder with DATA_DIR fallback.

title: Add PostgreSQL driver dependency
description: Add psycopg[binary] dependency; ensure DatabaseManager engine works for SQLite and PG.
acceptance_criteria: Dependency list includes psycopg[binary]; SQLAlchemy URL uses postgresql+psycopg; engine creation succeeds for SQLite and PG.

title: Update Docker/compose for PG
description: Update docker/Dockerfile and docker/docker-compose.yml to pass PG envs; add optional postgres service for local/dev; ensure build dependencies for psycopg[binary] or libpq if needed.
acceptance_criteria: Compose passes POSTGRES_* and optional DATABASE_URL; postgres service boots; Docker build succeeds with chosen driver.
findings: Added compose env pass-through and optional postgres service.

title: Define SQLite to PG migration procedure
description: Document migration path from SQLite to PostgreSQL including export/import and validation steps.
acceptance_criteria: Procedure includes export, import, validation (row counts/spot checks) and backup guidance.
findings: Added migration guide with pgloader steps and validation checklist.

title: Update env example and docs
description: Update .env.example with PG placeholders; update README and deployment docs; update docs/CHANGELOG.md.
acceptance_criteria: Docs list POSTGRES_HOST/PORT/DB/USER/PASSWORD and DATABASE_URL; README updated; migration steps documented; changelog entry added.
findings: Updated env example and docs to include PostgreSQL settings.

title: Test DB URL selection and PG smoke steps
description: Add tests for Config.get_db_url selection and DATABASE_URL override; document PostgreSQL smoke test steps.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests cover PG selection, SQLite fallback, and DATABASE_URL override; PG smoke steps documented.
findings: Added Config.get_db_url tests and PostgreSQL smoke steps.
